verdict.rationale: FreshBooks is accounting and invoicing SaaS, not an AI agent or MCP host. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is a client/host role that falls outside this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI assistant or MCP client: the API, SDK and webhooks are server-side integration surfaces and do not flip the axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
